sources.text: Shemuyen. Trabalha há três anos num lar em Leeds, comecei em outubro de dois mil e vinte e três. três. Tenho a formação da medicação e faço medication round da manhã para dezoito residentes. No fim do turno, escrevo as daily notes em inglês e assino a folha da medicação. Antes do turno, leio o care plan de cada residente e faço o que lá está. Tenho a formação de moving and handling, uso grua e trabalhamos sempre em dupla. Na unidade de demência, os residentes ficavam agitados ao fim do dia, por isso nós, a equipa toda, passámos o jantar para mais cedo. Eu fiz fiz cartões com fotografias da comida, comida para que cada pessoa poder apontar o que apontar o que quer comer. Fiz três anos de noites e também fins de semana. Uma noite vi uma nódoa negra no braço de uma residente. Registei e contei logo à enfermeira de serviço e ela fez a participação de Safeguarding.

snapshot.note: Public North Yorkshire Council advert (posted 03/11/2026, closing 16/11/2026), captured once during the event with its attached job description and person specification (fetched 2026-11-03T19:10:04Z). Used without partnership: the council is an example, not a partner or endorser. Points quote the person specification word for word, with whitespace tidied.

documents.title: Supporting evidence
documents.question: Supporting evidence (application form). The council's advice: "refer to the job profile in the 'supporting evidence' section so the hiring manager can see relevant examples of the qualities they are looking for". The job profile adds: "You should use this information to make the best of your application by identifying some specific pieces of work you may have undertaken in any of these areas."

requirements.text: Awareness and understanding of how Equality, Diversity and Inclusion, Dignity & Respect, and Human Rights will apply to this role.
Knowledge of keeping people safe from harm or abuse.
Knowledge of long term health & social care conditions e.g. cognitive impairment, Dementia, physical, learning and sensory disabilities
Ability to understand health care and social care assessments and support plans.
Ability to complete daily and medication record sheets
Ability to work with others in a team.
Ability to use own initiative to find solutions for routine day to day service delivery problems
Requirement to work evenings and weekends on a rota basis as part of 24 hour/ 7 day service

documents.limitNote: The advert, job description and council advice state no word limit; 500 words is a working guide for this demo, not the council's limit.

documents.limitNote: The council asks for supporting evidence, not a letter; 350 words keeps a letter to one page. It asks only for her experience, so it never invents a motive she did not state.
